_about: The Podcast (studied from 5 Diary of a CEO shorts, ~/reels/references/TheDiaryOfACEO): moody, contrasty colour picture; 1-3 words at a time in heavy white caps at the lower third, key words in yellow (danger words in red), a group with a key word stacks small-over-big; the hook question in a white box with black caps and an arrowed name label; a pull quote in quotes in the same box mid-video; a Like button that gets clicked; a pinned show logo top-left; punch-ins every ~2 s; a low cinematic bed.

director.plan: core/scripts/podcast_plan.py <project> writes captions.keys/reds, the hook box (+ name label), a pull quote, the Like click and the show logo.
director.rules: Everything on screen is spoken, except the show logo and the name label (brand kit data). Footage stays in colour.
director.prep: Landscape two-shots: prep with SPEAKER_CROP=1 (scripts/speaker_crop.py) so the crop frames the person talking, not the nearest face.
director.style: The Podcast: a moody, contrasty talking-head cut. Keep whole thoughts and cut hard between them; the picture changes about every 2 s. The footage stays in colour. Everything that appears on screen is a word the speaker actually says.
director.restraint: Apart from those two boxes the frame is the speaker, the captions and the punch-ins: no scenes, no pages, no cards, no icons, no B-roll, no stickers, no banner. If a box is not genuinely earned, leave it out and say so in the summary.
director.dont: Never a name, a company or a logo the speaker does not say.
director.boxline: One hook box over the opening: a white box of black heavy caps holding the line the speaker says there, in their own words.
director.pullquote: At most one pull quote in the middle of the reel: the same box in quote marks, holding the strongest complete line the speaker says, word for word.
director.keyword_treatments: The captions carry this look: about one strong content word per 7 spoken words gets `bold` (drawn big and yellow), and a genuine danger word - never, wrong, mistake, dead, lose - gets `alarm` (red), at most one per 15 s. EVERY occurrence of a word you mark is coloured, not just the one you timed, so only mark a word the speaker says once or twice; a plain negation (not, don't) stays white, and a filler, contraction or swear word is never a key word.
director.likeclick: One Like click about 40% in, between sentences, on reels of 12 s or more.
